description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ResourceTypeAndIdTrait' in the AWS SDK, providing methods to access resource type and ID from resource data, as well as a method to parse resource type and ID from a resource string.

classes.name: ResourceTypeAndIdTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait that provides methods to extract resource type and ID from resource data, and to parse these from a resource string.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type from the data array.

methods.name: getResourceId
methods.description: Returns the resource ID from the data array.

methods.name: parseResourceTypeAndId
methods.description: Parses the resource string to extract resource type and ID, and populates these in the data array.
